record.question: The essence or the main purpose of the British policies of moulding the Indian economy into colonial pattern was:
options: To earn profit for the company and its shareholders
To secure a favorable balance of trade for the mother country
To buy cheaply raw materials for the home industries and to sell dearly its manufactured goods
To secure the monopoly of Indian exports for the home country and its subjects.
record.explanation: Colonial policy aimed at buying cheap raw materials and selling dear manufactures.
